validation.semantics: Both notices name sending as the remedy: 'Basta con escribirle una vez en su conversación' / 'Busca su conversación en la barra lateral y escríbele una vez'. 'Escribirle (a alguien)' is the standard chat idiom for sending someone a message, and 'una vez' keeps 'one message'. Neither notice says that opening the conversation is enough, or that messages were refused, failed, read or lost ('está/están esperando a'). 'Basta con' renders the sufficiency the English imperative implies, in a calm news tone. Register is tú throughout (tu, Busca, escríbele), matching the file and style guide. hold.open uses an infinitive ('Escribir a …') per the es action-label rule, carries the verb sense of 'Message' and does not suggest sending. Terms: 'jefa de gabinete' equals ui.onboarding greeting_done/greeting_owed (9 occurrences across es, no drift). 'barra lateral' equals ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.*. 'su conversación' matches onboarding greeting_done. 'mensaje(s)' is consistent with the file. Button and both notices share the verb escribir. Note: ui.teamBridge.people.message renders 'Message {name}' as 'Enviar un mensaje a {name}'. That is a different namespace and no glossary entry exists, so it is not counted as drift.
